name: Nero
title: Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus
summary: Nero (Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus; 15 December 37 – 9 June 68) was Roman emperor from 54 to 68. He was the grandnephew, stepson, son-in-law and adopted son of Claudius, and great-great-grandson of Augustus. His early reign under the guidance of Seneca and Burrus was praised, but he later ordered the murder of his mother Agrippina and his wife Octavia. He was blamed for the Great Fire of Rome (64) and for persecuting Christians. His artistic pretensions and lavish spending alienated the Senate and army. He committed suicide after being deserted by the Praetorian Guard and sentenced to death by the Senate.
notes: Reign: 13 years, 7 months and 27 days. Nero was the last of the Julio-Claudian dynasty. His death triggered the Year of the Four Emperors. He was an enthusiastic patron of music, poetry, and chariot-racing. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nero_(emperor)
